title: Retire six writing rules into unplaceable-reference
summary: Six writing rules — bare-reference, reference-without-label, reference-without-link, chat-local-reference, undefined-name and undefined-name-at-start — are deleted, and everything they caught is folded into the single unplaceable-reference rule. Because ids that no longer exist would otherwise vanish silently, the change threads a retired-id table through every place a rule id can be named: suppression markers, `writing.levels` overrides, `osf-expect` fixture declarations, and `osf explain`. Each of those now reports the retired id as an error that names its replacement instead of a bare "not a rule id" or a silent no-op. The `writing.chat_local_labels` config key and its `OSF_WRITING_CHAT_LOCAL_LABELS` environment variable are removed with the same treatment: the key is refused with a message naming its replacements, and the variable is ignored with a one-line notice.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: main.rs
nodes.summary: Dispatches lint, verify and explain. `explain` now consults the retired-id table before the rule metadata, so a retired id prints its replacement and exits 0 instead of "no such rule".

nodes.label: verify / hook stages
nodes.subtitle: verify.rs
nodes.summary: Runs the pre-commit and pre-push checks. Its declared-fixture path now passes the retired-id table into the expectation check and turns retired declarations into `expectation-retired-rule` findings.

nodes.label: Config loader
nodes.subtitle: config.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves defaults, file, environment and flags. Drops `chat_local_labels`, rewrites the unknown-key error for it, rejects `writing.levels` entries naming retired rules, and prints a notice for the retired environment variable.

nodes.label: RETIRED_RULE_IDS
nodes.subtitle: lints/mod.rs
nodes.summary: The single table mapping each of the six deleted rule ids to `unplaceable-reference`. Every migration message in the change reads from it.

nodes.label: Writing lint
nodes.subtitle: lints/writing
nodes.summary: Runs the sentence and paragraph rules. The six deleted rules are gone from the rule set; `unplaceable-reference` now also emits the link warning the retired link rule carried, and every finding resolves its level from its own evidence.

nodes.label: Rule metadata
nodes.subtitle: lints/writing/meta.rs
nodes.summary: The explain text for each rule. The six retired entries are removed and `unplaceable-reference`'s text absorbs the labelled-but-unlinked case.

nodes.label: Expectation check
nodes.subtitle: expectation.rs
nodes.summary: Compares a fixture's declared rule ids against what fired. It now takes the retired table and reports a declared retired id in its own `retired` bucket, pointing at the replacement, without also flagging the replacement as unexpected.

nodes.label: Suppression engine
nodes.subtitle: suppress.rs
nodes.summary: Parses `osf-disable` markers and validates the rule ids they name. A retired id is still an error, but the message now names the rule that replaced it.

nodes.label: Human / SARIF renderers
nodes.subtitle: human.rs, sarif.rs
nodes.summary: Unchanged in behaviour; their tests were updated to the surviving rule id.

nodes.label: osf.toml
nodes.subtitle: writing section
nodes.summary: The repository's own config. Its comment now names `unplaceable-reference` where it named `undefined-name`.

nodes.label: Writing fixtures
nodes.subtitle: tests/fixtures/writing
nodes.summary: The fixture corpus. Declarations naming retired ids are stripped, the chat-local label pair is deleted, and a new fixture covers a labelled repository reference with no link.

nodes.label: Agent adapters
nodes.subtitle: integrations/*
nodes.summary: The dsh, omp and opencode adapters read the CLI's refusal reason. Their tests and docs now quote `unplaceable-reference`.
